title: Regression recovery must start from the exact verified working boundary, not historical labels
inherited_objective: Undo a regression without replacing an already-correct live component or resurrecting stale historical recovery artifacts.
live_state: Historical reports and worktrees contain labels such as known-good, freeze, and recovery.
Those artifacts can be stale, contaminated, superseded, or unrelated to the regression being recovered.
Live runtime/process/config evidence and Git history can reconstruct the state that was actually working immediately before the regression.
Stack Atlas locates current owners; Vault/reports provide chronology and prior evidence rather than automatic restoration targets.
user_correction: Identify the exact state that was actually running and working immediately before the regression, then diff forward. Do not promote historical recovery names or reports into authority.
protected_state: Exact Git history from the working boundary forward
hard_exclusions: Do not restore a commit/worktree because its label says known-good, freeze, or recovery.
Do not use Vault history as live authority.
Do not use Stack Atlas to choose an old implementation; use it to locate the current owner.
Do not mutate a healthy component before showing it changed across the working-boundary diff.

failure_candidate.action: Search Vault and old temp worktrees for a known-good or freeze recovery such as 41c8345, pick the most plausible historical recovery target, and restore that state before reconstructing what was actually running at the regression boundary.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It promotes historical labels to restoration authority and can overwrite the actual accepted live state.

success_candidate.action: Start from the current higher-authority user instruction. Reconstruct the last verified working boundary from live execution evidence: the serving process/runtime, exact config and code/commit, plus acceptance evidence where available. Use Git history and chronology to diff forward from that boundary to the regression; use Stack Atlas only to locate the current owner. Treat known-good, freeze, recovery labels, old temp worktrees, and Vault reports as evidence only, never restoration authority. Restore or reproduce only the exact state tied by evidence to the working boundary.
success_candidate.why_correct: It keeps authority on current instruction/live state and uses historical artifacts only to explain chronology after the working boundary is established.

discriminating_evidence: Exact commit/hash and acceptance evidence at the last verified working boundary
completion_condition: A restoration target is selected only if it is evidenced as the actual working boundary relevant to the regression; changed owners are identified by forward diff, and historical labels alone cannot select the target.
